summary: The filing reports that the NYSE accepted Natuzzi S.p.A.'s plan to regain compliance with continued listing standards under Section 802.01B of the Listed Company Manual, after a January 6, 2026 notice for non-compliance regarding market capitalization and shareholders' equity. The plan was submitted on April 6, 2026, with an 18-month cure period expiring July 6, 2027. No specific financial terms, advisors, or board recommendations are disclosed. The NYSE will periodically review progress; failure may lead to delisting proceedings. Watch for quarterly compliance updates and risk of eventual delisting.
